summary: WF Holding Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a marketed unit offering: up to 12,000,000 units at $1.50 each (one ordinary share or pre-funded warrant plus one ordinary warrant), for gross proceeds up to $18,000,000, with an Additional Allocation right of up to 100% exercisable within 30 days for a further $18,000,000. Ordinary Warrants are immediately exercisable at $1.50, expire October 14, 2027, and carry a 9.0x zero-price exercise feature, implying up to 108,000,000 shares and no cash exercise proceeds. This is a routine registered capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant-driven dilution and share overhang.
